summary: Implement in-app toast notifications for key user events (availability added, leaderboard rank increase).
architectural_notes: Prefer in-app notifications (toasts) over push; Internet Computer environment may not support traditional push services (e.g., Firebase), so notifications are primarily shown while the app is open.

existing_features.title: Add a global toast renderer so in-app toast notifications can be shown from any page using the existing `sonner` toast calls.
Show an in-app toast notification when the user successfully adds (or updates) an availability entry from the Add Availability page.
Show an in-app toast notification on the Leaderboard page when the current user’s rank improves (moves to a smaller rank number) after leaderboard data refreshes.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add in-app toast notification when a user adds new availability
Add in-app toast notification when a user moves up in rank on the leaderboard tab

projectName: Add in-app toast notifications for availability creation and leaderboard rank increases
